description: MEASURED NOW, not from a status page: outage.me makes one HTTPS request to the site's home page from five AWS regions (US, Europe, Asia-Pacific, South America) and returns per-location outcome and timings (DNS, connect, TLS, total), the CDN/host it runs on, the official status of the provider behind it when tracked, and a finding: up_everywhere (probably the user's side), down_everywhere, down_in_some_regions or inconclusive. Use it when a site or API host fails for the user. Hostname only (no path or port); public sites only. Answers are reused for 60 s. Needs sign-in or an API key, and is quota-limited per day. Deterministic: no model in the loop.

host.description: The site's hostname, e.g. 'github.com' or 'api.stripe.com'. A URL is accepted; only its host is used.

name: check_site
title: Is it just me? Check a website from five locations now
